Types: LayoutMode 'agent' | 'chat' replaces 'servant'. settings-store.ts persists layoutMode under 'synapse-settings' (version: 1 + migrate mapping 'servant'→'agent'); setLayoutMode('agent') auto-opens right sidebar. route.tsx rewritten: ResizablePanel right panel driven by mode (chat = hidden/collapsed panel, agent = expanded + right sidebar), mobile Sheet branch via useIsMobile, transition-[flex-grow,flex-basis] duration-300 ease-in-out, toggleRightSidebar switches chat→agent, effect syncs panel collapse/expand. app-top-header.tsx: ToggleGroup mode switch (array-based value from base-ui), right-sidebar toggle hidden in chat mode, aria-pressed toggle, @container/top-header container queries. app-right-sidebar.tsx made container-agnostic (plain divs, no useIsMobile). centered prop threaded chat-page → companion-chat → chat-bot (mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl). i18n: sidebar_mode_agent(_desc) renamed from sidebar_mode_servant, header_mode_toggle_aria.

features.name: Chat Enhancements: First-Click Fix, Pagination, Favorites Filter
features.description: Three chat fixes (2026-08-11). (C1) ChatBot only mounts after isLoadingConversation settles — fixes first-click-no-response by gating on a stale empty-message check. (C2) Message pagination: backend GET /conversations/:id/messages?limit&offset (messagesQuerySchema limit default 15 max 100 offset default 0, repository findMessagesByConversationIdPage DESC LIMIT/OFFSET then reverse to chronological); client useGetConversationMessagesInfiniteQuery (MESSAGE_PAGE_SIZE=15, initialPageParam 0, getNextPageParam = lastPage.length===15 ? sum : undefined, chronological via [...pages].reverse().flat()); ChatBot forwardRef ChatBotHandle { prependMessages (chat.setMessages), sendText }; ConversationLoadOlder scroll-top listener (scrollRef scrollTop <= 1, anchor restored via scrollTop += scrollHeight - prevHeight) + top spinner; centered layout. (C3) nav-companion Recents filters out favorited conversations (recents = !favorited).
features.evidence: services/ai/src/conversation/schemas.ts (messagesQuerySchema), repository.ts (findMessagesByConversationIdPage), services.ts (loadMessagesPage), route.ts (query validator), index.ts, src/features/companion/types/api.ts (query { limit, offset }), hooks/use-companion-conversation.ts (useGetConversationMessagesInfiniteQuery), components/chat-bot.tsx (ChatBotHandle + ConversationLoadOlder + centered), components/companion-chat.tsx (mount gating + pages orchestration), components/layouts/app-sidebar/nav-companion.tsx (recents filter)

features.name: Chat Bug-Fix Pass: Chat-Mode Navigation + Older-Message Loading
features.description: Three chat bug fixes (2026-08-11, on top of staged feat-044..047). (1) Chat-mode conversation click did nothing: no /chat/:conversationId route existed and nav-companion only set the store + opened the collapsed right panel. New route src/routes/_app/chat.$conversationId.tsx (createFileRoute '/_app/chat/$conversationId', effect setActiveConversationId(conversationId)); nav-companion handleSelectConversation now navigates in chat mode (agent mode stays sidebar-only per user). (2) /chat = new chat: chat.tsx mount effect setActiveConversationId(null); handleNewChat navigates to /chat in chat mode. (3) Scroll-to-top spinner flashed but older messages never appeared: @ai-sdk/react@4.0.50 useChat seeds messages once in a useRef (new Chat only recreated when id changes), so growth in useGetConversationMessagesInfiniteQuery data.pages was ignored. chat-bot.tsx: prop initialMessages renamed to messages (live full list) + useLayoutEffect diffing chat.messages vs loadedMessages prepends missing older via chat.setMessages(prev => [...older, ...prev]) (layout effect commits before ConversationLoadOlder passive-effect scroll-delta restore); render uses liveMessages (chat state). ConversationLoadOlder mount-time handleScroll() removed so atTop only true on real user scrolls (no spurious fetch chaining on open). Verified: generate-routes, tsc -b, check, build.
features.evidence: src/routes/_app/chat.$conversationId.tsx (NEW), src/routes/_app/chat.tsx (reset-on-mount), src/components/layouts/app-sidebar/nav-companion.tsx (useNavigate chat-mode), src/features/companion/components/chat-bot.tsx (messages prop + prepend useLayoutEffect + ConversationLoadOlder mount handleScroll removal), src/features/companion/components/companion-chat.tsx (messages prop), src/routeTree.gen.ts (regenerated)
